starting_balance_usd.source: 2026 CME Group University Trading Challenge — Competition Rules, Regulations and Requirements (plan/RULES.md), p9 General Rules for Trading: "Beginning account balances: - $1,000,000"

daily_loss_cap_pct.source: 2026 CME Group University Trading Challenge — Competition Rules, Regulations and Requirements (plan/RULES.md), p9: "If a team loses 20% of its available account balance in one day, the account is locked for the remainder of the trading day."
daily_loss_cap_pct.note: Base = prior trade date's closing balance (Daily tab), $1,000,000 before the first close; loss = −(realized today + open P&L). Interpretation chosen by Ilan 2026-10-01.

max_drawdown_usd.note: No drawdown rule in the 2026 UTC rules

max_contracts.note: p9: "The number of contracts traded is limited to the margin requirements posted in the rules." No fixed count.

micro_to_standard_ratio.note: No contract-count limit, so no micro ratio

flatten_time_ct.source: 2026 CME Group University Trading Challenge — Competition Rules, Regulations and Requirements (plan/RULES.md), p9: "On the last day of the competition, teams must have all positions closed 15 minutes prior to the market close or they will be auto-liquidated"; p6: "Concludes Friday, October 30 at 4:00 p.m. CT"
flatten_time_ct.note: 15:45 CT = 15 min before the 16:00 CT close. Product closes vary (p6: "Trading hours vary per contract"); check your product.

flatten_dates.source: 2026 CME Group University Trading Challenge — Competition Rules, Regulations and Requirements (plan/RULES.md), p6/p9/p10: last day of the competition only; $1,000 per open contract penalty plus auto-liquidation

hold_margin_multipliers.source: 2026 CME Group University Trading Challenge — Competition Rules, Regulations and Requirements (plan/RULES.md), p9: "All accounts should maintain proper margin at all times." No intraday/overnight/weekend distinction in the rules
hold_margin_multipliers.note: 1 = exchange margin as posted, any hold

margin_basis.source: Rules silent (p9 'maintain proper margin'); Ilan chose initial margin 2026-10-01 (conservative)

allowed_roots.note: p7: "Teams will be able to trade all the supported CME Group futures products" — no restriction

challenge_start_date.source: 2026 CME Group University Trading Challenge — Competition Rules, Regulations and Requirements (plan/RULES.md), p6: "Begins Sunday, October 4 at 5:00 p.m. CT" (first trade date Mon 2026-10-05)

challenge_end_date.source: 2026 CME Group University Trading Challenge — Competition Rules, Regulations and Requirements (plan/RULES.md), p6: "Concludes Friday, October 30 at 4:00 p.m. CT"

min_contracts_per_day.source: 2026 CME Group University Trading Challenge — Competition Rules, Regulations and Requirements (plan/RULES.md), p9/p10: "Teams are required to execute at least 10 contracts per day … can be an entry (long or short) or an exit"; $1,000 penalty per day below 10

commission_per_side_usd.source: 2026 CME Group University Trading Challenge — Competition Rules, Regulations and Requirements (plan/RULES.md), p9: "A commission of $2.50 is charged per traded contract per side."
